title: 三表法测线圈参数
statement: 用三表法测一个实际电感线圈（模型为 R 与 L 串联）的参数，电源频率 f = 50 Hz。
电压表 V 接在线圈两端，电流表 A 与线圈串联；功率表 W 的电流线圈与电流表串联、电压线圈并接在线圈两端（图中未画出）。
测得（仪表读数都是有效值）：电压表读数 V = 100 V，电流表读数 I = 2 A，功率表读数 P = 120 W。求线圈的阻抗模 |Z|、电阻 R、感抗 X_L 和功率因数。

questions.explain: 功率表测的是线圈吸收的有功功率，只有 R 消耗有功：R = P/I² = 120/4 = 30 Ω。

questions.ask: 线圈的功率因数 cos φ = ?

hints: 电压表、电流表的读数之比就是阻抗模。
功率表读数是线圈吸收的有功功率，而有功功率只消耗在电阻上：P = I²R。
再由阻抗三角形 |Z|² = R² + X_L² 求 X_L。
solution: **2. 电阻。** 功率表读数 P = V·I·cos φ 是线圈吸收的有功功率，电感不消耗有功，所以 P = I²R，R = 120/2² = **30 Ω**。
这就是“三表法”：一块电压表、一块电流表、一块功率表就能测出未知阻抗 Z = R + jX_L = 30 + j40 Ω（感性还是容性需另行判断）。

en.title: Three-meter method for a coil
statement: A real inductor coil (modelled as R in series with L) is measured with the three-meter method at f = 50 Hz.
Voltmeter V is across the coil and ammeter A is in series with it; the wattmeter W has its current coil in series with the ammeter and its voltage coil across the coil (not drawn).
Readings (all meters read rms values): voltmeter V = 100 V, ammeter I = 2 A, wattmeter P = 120 W. Find the coil's impedance magnitude |Z|, its resistance R, its reactance X_L and its power factor.

questions.explain: The wattmeter reads the real power absorbed by the coil, and only R consumes real power: R = P/I² = 120/4 = 30 Ω.

questions.ask: Power factor of the coil, cos φ = ?
questions.explain: cos φ = P/(V·I) = 120/200 = 0.6 (lagging), which also equals R/|Z| = 30/50.

hints: The ratio of the voltmeter and ammeter readings is the impedance magnitude.
The wattmeter reads the real power absorbed by the coil, and real power is consumed only in the resistance: P = I²R.
Then use the impedance triangle |Z|² = R² + X_L² to get X_L.
solution: **2. Resistance.** The wattmeter reading P = V·I·cos φ is the real power absorbed by the coil; the inductance consumes none, so P = I²R and R = 120/2² = **30 Ω**.
**4. Power factor.** cos φ = P/(UI) = 120/200 = **0.6** (inductive, lagging), φ = 53.13°.
This is the three-meter method: a voltmeter, an ammeter and a wattmeter determine an unknown impedance Z = R + jX_L = 30 + j40 Ω (whether it is inductive or capacitive must be decided separately).
